name: Swig (Draper / Herriman / Orem / Logan) Warm Sugar Cookie & Caffeine-Free / Non-Carbonated Drink Guide
whyItWorks: Swig's famous chilled pink-frosted Sugar Cookie is made with fine white flour, butter, and powdered-sugar icing (zero nuts or seeds); if stopping at the drive-thru with friends, pair half a cookie with a non-carbonated, non-citrus water refresher rather than carbonated soda + lime.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a classic Frosted Sugar Cookie or warm Pretzel Bites (no jalapeño cheese) and, if ordering a drink, choose a still Water base with light coconut/vanilla/strawberry puree—strictly NO fresh lime/lemon wedges and NO carbonated soda during flares.
watchOuts: Most signature Swig "Dirty Sodas" combine heavy carbonation, caffeine, high-fructose corn syrup, and fresh lime/lemon wedges (citrus trigger)—skip the lime/lemon completely
